thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: elevated ELB 5xx and connection resets observed in us-west-2 (spike starting ~2851234500). Auto-page to on-call @sara_oncall :rotating_light:
sara_oncall: I'm on. Seeing a large number of outbound failures from app hosts -> AWS endpoints. Initial look points at NAT Gateway port allocation exhaustion / conntrack high, causing egress stalls and IMDS timeouts, which in turn are failing EBS detach/register ops and making ELB targets go unhealthy.
lee_infra: Confirmed in VPC flow logs and CloudWatch: NATGateway:PortAllocationFailed entries and heavy TCP RSTs. Sample flow log excerpt:
```
DROP,10.0.3.21,13.248.118.1,12345,443,6,0x40,PortAllocationFailed
```
mohit_sre: Can we provision additional NAT gateways in the two affected AZs? Also consider temporary route53 traffic steering away from usw2 while we fix.
sara_oncall: Spawning 2 additional NAT gateways now in usw2a/usw2b. Also preparing a Route53 weighted failover to shift new traffic to us-east as a mitigation (reduce load on healing AZs). Notifying support for customer comms.
ryan_platform: Heads up: shifting weight to us-east will increase latency for some customers — support to prep outbound note.
kate_support: On it, drafting short customer-facing update. Will post here for review.
sara_oncall: Route53 change request (will apply scoped weight change to api.prod):
```
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z3EXAMPLE --change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"api.prod.redwood.com","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"us-east-weight","Weight":90,"AliasTarget":{"HostedZoneId":"Z2EXAMPLE","DNSName":"dualstack-alb-us-east-1.amazonaws.com","EvaluateTargetHealth":false}}}]}'
```
deploy-bot: ran smoke on staging with the same change; canary looks ok. Applying to prod in 2m.
lee_infra: NAT gateways provisioned, but kernel conntrack still rising because of short-lived ephemeral ports churn. I recommend enabling HTTP keepalive on the service and doing a rolling restart to reduce port churn.
sara_oncall: Rolling update to set keepalive (HTTP_KEEPALIVE=true) on rl-service replicas. Command: `kubectl set env deploy/rl-service HTTP_KEEPALIVE=true -n prod`
mohit_sre: Also lowering ELB idle_timeout to 30s temporarily to free sockets sooner. Applying config now.
lee_infra: Noted a handful of EBS detach attempts that timed out earlier; logs showed IMDS call timeouts during detach: `Error DetachingVolume: timeout waiting for volume deletion`. Those ops retried and completed after NAT provisioned.
sara_oncall: Route53 weight shift executed at 2851234705 — stepped us-west weight down to 10%, us-east up to 90%. Monitoring latency and error rates.
kate_support: Customer note draft: "We are mitigating a networking issue affecting a subset of servers in us-west-2. Traffic has been temporarily shifted to us-east to reduce impact. We're actively monitoring — no data loss reported." Ready to send once approved.
mohit_sre: Taking the pager for the next 2 hours. Handoff: actions completed — NAT add, conntrack mitigation (keepalive rollout), ELB idle timeout tweak, Route53 weight shift. Next steps: monitor ELB 5xx rate, verify EBS ops, and ensure conntrack normalizes.
sara_oncall: Thanks — escalating to infra lead if customer error rate > 2% for > 15m. Leaving channel. :white_check_mark:
mohit_sre: Incident tag INC-2026-2851. I'll post a post-incident summary after stabilization and add conntrack tuning to the playbook.
incident-bot: Incident state updated: INVESTIGATING -> MITIGATING (timestamp 2851234800). Tags: natgw, conntrack, route53, elb.
mohit_sre: ELB 5xxs trending back to baseline, we still have one noisy host reprobed for socket reuse. Keeping channel open for metrics stabilization and will update at 2851240200 for closure/handoff.
kate_support: Notified top-10 affected customers via templated message and monitoring replies for escalations.
ryan_platform: Suggest follow-up: quantify traffic shifted and impact on p99 latency across regions, we should add auto-nat scale docs for future.
mohit_sre: Agree. Also will add automated conntrack alert thresholds and a runbook entry to rotate NATs before port exhaustion.
lee_infra: Confirming no EBS volumes stuck. Closing infra remediation checklist.
mohit_sre: Closing the active pager in 10m if metrics hold. Leaving channel open for final signoff.
